title: DENR urges golf courses to save water amid El Niño

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) said it is planning to issue a directive urging golf courses in Metro Manila to use recycled water, among other conservation measures, to help mitigate the effects of El Niño. Environment Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna made the statement during a Palace press briefing on Monday, after he was asked if the agency plans to renew a 2024 directive for golf courses to use recycled water when irrigating their fairways, greens, tees, rough, grass patches, and plants.
